entities.summary: Nürnberger Flugdienst Flight 108 was a scheduled regional flight which crashed near Essen, West Germany, on 8 February 1988 with the loss of all 21 occupants. The flight was operated by Swearingen SA-227AC Metroliner III D-CABB for Nürnberger Flugdienst, from Hannover Airport to Düsseldorf Airport. It is the deadliest single-aircraft accident involving the Swearingen Fairchild Metroliner.
